note: The alate measurements are based on 8 individuals and the soldier measurements on the holotype and 4 paratypes (tables 33 and 34); the species name refers to the truncated head shape of the soldier.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text:
The alate is closely related to G. asperatus, from which it differs in the darker colour, the shorter tibiae, the shorter and narrower pronotum and the slightly longer wings; compared with G. angustus the ocelli are smaller and the pronotum narrower and shorter; compared with G. perparvus the eyes and ocelli are larger and the pronotum narrower and shorter. The soldier has a shorter head than G. asperatus, more rounded and blunter frontal lobes, a depression on each side of the frontal slope below the lobes, a narrower median frontal notch, and a shorter postmentum.

Type locality: near Porcecito, Colombia (about 6°—8° N, 75°—76°45′ W), Rio Porce, altitude 3300 ft; the alates (morphotype and paramorphotypes) and soldiers (holotype and paratypes) were collected by N. A. Weber on 18 August 1938, no. 973, from a small stump.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head rusty brown; pronotum brown, paler than the head, with a dark T-shaped mark in the middle; antennae pale smoky brown; labrum and legs yellowish brown; tergites rusty brown; wings smoky, wing scales darker. Head and pronotum with few scattered erect setae. Y-shaped suture faintly visible. Eyes shaped as in the figure. Ocelli oblique, touching the eye. Antennae 11—12-segmented; in the 11-segmented condition the third segment is longer than the fourth, in the 12-segmented condition the third and fourth are equal. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin concave, sides rounded, posterior margin straight. Hindwing media arising from the radial sector, the point of origin beyond the wing scale, about 0.75 mm from the wing suture.

Measurements of 8 alates (range/mean): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 0.98—1.05 mm/0.98 mm; head length (to the mandibular base) 0.75—0.83 mm/0.76 mm; head width 0.77—0.83 mm/0.79 mm; eye diameter 0.25—0.28 mm/0.26 mm; distance to the lower eye margin 0.09—0.11 mm/0.11 mm; ocellus length 0.07—0.09 mm/0.08 mm; median pronotum length 0.39—0.41 mm/0.40 mm; pronotum width 0.60—0.68 mm/0.65 mm; hind tibia length 0.64 mm; forewing length from the suture 4.10—4.53 mm/4.33 mm; forewing width 1.09—1.23 mm/1.15 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head brown, dark reddish brown to nearly black in front; mandibles blackish brown; pronotum reddish brown; antennae, legs and tergites pale yellowish brown. Head with few scattered erect setae; margins and disc of the pronotum with a few long and short setae; labral apex with 2 setae. Head short, thick, truncate; sides slightly convergent forwards; frontal region vertical, with a depression on each side; frons bilobed, with a wide and deep median notch; lobes broadly rounded, margins rough; a small process below the antennal socket. Eyes small, oval. Mandibles short, broad at the base; left mandible with 3 small marginal teeth; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the first marginal tooth 0.21 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Postmentum shaped as in the figure. Antennae 10—11-segmented, the third segment longer than or equal to the fourth. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin concave with a small median notch, posterolateral margins rounded, posterior margin deeply concave in the middle. Femora slightly swollen.

Soldier measurements (holotype; range/mean of 4): head length (to the mandibular base) 1.13 mm/1.05—1.13 mm/1.09 mm; head width 0.98 mm/0.91—0.98 mm/0.95 mm; head height 0.90 mm/0.90—0.91 mm/0.90 mm; left mandible length 0.60 mm/0.60 mm; maximum postmentum width 0.36 mm/0.34—0.36 mm/0.36 mm; minimum postmentum width 0.26—0.28 mm/0.27 mm; postmentum length 0.56 mm/0.56—0.59 mm/0.58 mm; median pronotum length 0.44 mm/0.41—0.45 mm/0.43 mm; maximum pronotum length 0.53 mm/0.53—0.54 mm; pronotum width 0.86 mm/0.86—0.90 mm/0.87 mm; hind tibia length 0.57 mm/0.57 mm.
